verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents an official MCP server that lets an AI assistant build audiences, manage syncs, design journeys, generate creatives and analyze performance "in plain language," with concrete example prompts. Its docs also describe a built-in agent for exploring segments and analyzing campaigns in natural language. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works as described, and documented natural-language coverage of other product areas such as Events, Identity Resolution and model authoring.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: the Hightouch MCP server connects your AI assistant directly to your marketing stack so your team can build audiences, manage syncs, design journeys, generate emails and ads, and analyze performance — all in plain language.
use the built-in agent to explore segments and analyze campaign performance in natural language.
All customers: Understand your customer schema, build audiences, create and analyze journeys, manage syncs, and create syncs from templates.
Generate visual ad creatives from a prompt, refine them with follow-up instructions, and browse existing projects.
